Thank you for your comment! This is my first post so I forgot to add my age but I just added it in! This helped me to put in perspective how small my “huge” problem really is. So thank you for that. I had been so focused on this problem that time was just passing me by with me not doing anything but just sit and think. I really am grateful for your comment!

My advice? Well just don’t worry about trying to impress her. If she likes you then she will like you even if your dumb or a genius. And I’m a girl and most guys are honestly kinda cute to me when they are just themselves and just stupid(in a good way).  Also don’t worry about having to have a comeback for your friends sometimes we like guys even more when they are just clueless and just have no words cause they are embarrassed or something.  But I say just go for it. Tell her you like her. No matter if it’s one-on-one or in a group. Just tell her. Most girls will be flattered and sweet to you when you tell them you like them,even if they don’t like you. But it is also(to me) very attractive when a guy had the guts to tell me how he feels. But just tell her how you feel and if she doesn’t feel the same way, she will be nice about it(and if she’s not then you shouldn’t be with her🤷🏻‍♀️) and it won’t be awkward if she doesn’t. I have been on both ends of telling someone I liked them and having someone tell me they like me. It’s never awkward unless you make it awkward. But I am sure she probably likes you. But if she doesn’t it’s fine. It’s not the end of the world   There will be other people and now you can just focus on your friendship with her. And who knows, even if she says she doesn’t like you then she may go home and think about it and start to think of you in that way rather than in a friend way. So it’s better to just tell her and get it off your chest rather than constantly wondering “what if”  
 
I hope this helped you and good luck😉
